sara_marketing: Kickoff — we need a social plan for next Wed's launch. X + LinkedIn. Three posts: teaser (Mon AM), launch post (Wed 10:30 PT), follow thread (Wed 11 PT). Include benchmark narrative callout and webinar CTA. Routing: HubSpot form -> qualify -> SDR queue. @tom_content can you draft the copy variants?

 tom_content: Yep. I'll do 3 headline options + 2 thread styles (product-first vs customer-story). ETA EOD today.

 nick_growth: For timing, let's localize the posting times for NA/EU/APAC. Can we do staggered windows: 10:30 PT (NA), 15:30 BST (EU), 00:30 SGT (APAC) for max reach? Also recommend pinned CTA link to webinar.

 jenny_ops: FYI ops: we'll need the embed link for the webinar (Zoom w/ branded landing) and the HubSpot form ID. I'll set up a rule: if lead_source == "social_launch" tag and page_views > 1 then route to High intent SDR pool.

 sara_marketing: Great. Also add a short benchmark card image showing latency/cost improvement — use #benchmark_narratives assets. Can we get a simplified 3-stat image?

 tom_content: Uploading draft copies now -> https://drive.redwood/launch-copy/1799999998

 social_bot: Scheduled preview generated for X: https://preview.redwood/social/1799999998 :eyes:

 nick_growth: A/B test idea: variant A uses numbers ("2x throughput, 1/2 cost"), variant B uses user story. We'll compare CTR + form completions over 72h. Can we add UTMs: utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=variantA or variantB

 jenny_ops: Added routing rules in HubSpot + slack alert to #sales-inbound. Will post mapping in the ops doc.

 sara_marketing: Perfect. Next steps: tom finalize copy by 6pm, design to make benchmark image by tomorrow 11am PT, ops confirms HubSpot rule + landing by EOD. Thanks :tada:
